title: AboutResult
description: What the launcher is. A client asks this first, to learn whether it speaks to the launcher it found.

version.description: The version stamped into the launcher at build. Absent from a development build, which states none.

development.description: Whether this is a development build: one with no version stamped.

commit.description: The commit it was built from, when stamped.

built.description: When it was built, when stamped.

apiVersions.description: Each version of the control API it speaks. A client that speaks none of them stops here.

imageRegistry.description: The registry its catalog's images come from.

runtimes.description: Each container runtime it drives, in the order it prefers them, and whether this machine has it.
